quote: DateTime::createFromImmutable() now has a tentative return type of static, previously it was DateTime.
reason: An override in a class that extends DateTime and declares a return type other than static is visible in the class declaration and raises the notice when the class is declared; overrides without a return type are an 8.1 matter and #[\ReturnTypeWillChange] silences it (both shown by runtime fixtures).

quote: DateTimeImmutable::createFromMutable() now has a tentative return type of static, previously it was DateTimeImmutable.
reason: Same check as for DateTime::createFromImmutable(): an override with a return type other than static in a class that extends DateTimeImmutable.

quote: The ODBC extension now escapes the username and password for the case when both a connection string and username/password are passed, and the string must be appended to.
reason: None of the runtimes has the odbc extension (extension_loaded("odbc") is false on 7.4 to 8.5), and the effect depends on the credential values at run time.

quote: The PDO_ODBC extension also escapes the username and password when a connection string is passed.
reason: None of the runtimes has the pdo_odbc driver (PDO::getAvailableDrivers() lists only mysql and sqlite), and the effect depends on the credential values at run time.

quote: glob() returns empty array if all paths are restricted by open_basedir.
reason: Depends on the open_basedir setting and on the paths at run time; the glob() call looks the same either way.

quote: strtolower() and strtoupper() are no longer locale-sensitive.
reason: Depends on the locale set at run time and on the bytes of the string; the runtimes here have no locale data, so the fixture shows the same output on every version and the change itself could not be observed.

quote: str_split() returns an empty array for an empty string now.
reason: Only an empty string at run time is affected; a literal empty string as the argument is not something plugin code plausibly writes.

quote: ksort() and krsort() do numeric string comparison under SORT_REGULAR using the standard PHP 8 rules now.
reason: The order only changes for arrays that mix numeric and non-numeric string keys at run time.

quote: The following methods now enforce their signature:
reason: Calls with extra arguments throw ArgumentCountError from 8.2, but whether $x->ftell( 1 ) is called on an SplFileObject is known at run time only.

quote: SplFileObject::hasChildren() now has a tentative return type of false, previously it was bool
reason: An override with a return type other than false in a class that extends SplFileObject or SplTempFileObject raises the notice when the class is declared.

quote: SplFileObject::getChildren() now has a tentative return type of null, previously it was ?RecursiveIterator
reason: An override with a return type other than null in a class that extends SplFileObject or SplTempFileObject raises the notice when the class is declared.

quote: GlogIterator returns empty array if all paths are restricted by open_basedir.
reason: Depends on the open_basedir setting and on the paths at run time.

quote: Creation of dynamic properties is deprecated, unless the class opts in by using the #[AllowDynamicProperties] attribute.
reason: Only "$this->name = ..." (also ??=, the other compound assignments and ++/--) inside a method of a class that extends nothing, uses no trait, is not abstract, has no __set() and no #[AllowDynamicProperties], and declares no such property, is certain from the file; every other object is a run-time matter (runtime fixtures).

quote: Callables that are not accepted by the $callable() syntax (but are accepted by call_user_func) are deprecated.
reason: String and array literals of the listed forms written directly as the callable argument of known internal functions are visible; callables in variables are not (runtime fixture).

quote: The "${var}" and "${expr}" style string interpolations are deprecated and will be removed in PHP 9.
reason: Covered by the existing rule string.dollar_brace (DollarBrace.php), which reports both forms; the "${expr}" form has a fixture of this tranche.

quote: Use of QPrint, Base64, Uuencode, and HTML-ENTITIES 'text encodings' is deprecated for all Mbstring functions.
reason: A literal encoding name in the encoding argument of the mbstring functions that do raise the notice is visible; the runtimes showed that some functions and the source encoding of mb_convert_encoding() raise nothing, and names in variables are a run-time matter.

quote: The SplFileInfo::_bad_state_ex() internal method has been deprecated.
reason: An undocumented internal method; the class of the object it is called on is known at run time only, and a user class may have a method of that name.

quote: utf8_encode() and utf8_decode() have been deprecated.
reason: data/catalog/functions.php lists both as deprecated in 8.2 (evidence verified), reported by InternalFunctions.
